summary: Paramount Skydance Corp filed an 8-K/A amending pro forma financials to correct an exhibit table detailing debt exchange offers and consent solicitations involving its DCL Issuer and DGH Issuer subsidiaries. The filing lists aggregate principal amounts of existing WBD notes validly delivered (e.g., $4.1B of 5.050% notes due 2042) eligible for exchange into senior secured second lien notes. This reflects a liability management transaction, likely tied to broader restructuring following the Skydance merger. The amendment only corrects a table; no new event occurred. Watch for consent thresholds and exchange completion rates affecting the balance sheet.
